mostWorthwhile.text: Making rain-filled hollows was worthwhile: it connected the emerging ocean to existing low places and clarified that rain did not excavate Earth's ocean basins.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting Lunar rhythm revealed no available combinations after an unexpected detour, making the route to the shore less clear.

surprise.text: My attempt to combine water with crust instead produced tides with the Moon; the explanation of the Moon's uneven gravitational pull made that connection clear.

arbitrary.text: Combining Tides with the Moon to make Lunar rhythm felt unclear in purpose, especially because the result had no available partners.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what develops at the tidal shore, particularly if later combinations continue to distinguish the mythic gestures from the science.
